differences.what: T-2579: the camera is re-fitted to six controls on Keith's own front (both pinnacle apexes, a third-storey jamb at head and sill, a bow light at head and sill): RMS 4.6 px, about 0.22 m at 58 m. Pinnacles, parapet, the upper lights and the bow head now register; what still differs is the building, below.
Flat top, south bow ending below the continuous third-storey arcade, and pierced parapet are present.
Fine carving, granite colour and lower details behind cars are below resolution or hidden. The demolished neighbours and later street are not the 1904 target.
The original is monochrome; granite colour is not shown. Sepia/scan casts are not material colour.

T-2581: the south face's front strip is built: coursed stone from grade to the parapet, 2.1 m behind the south-east pinnacle, where the model laid brick with toothed quoins; the photograph's strip runs on behind the pole at x 262, so this view bounds it from below and the mid-1950s view's downpipe sets its end.
T-2679: re-read after the crown changed: at this distance the band, the lattice head and the north-east boss are a few pixels and the picture cannot tell the old crown from the new.

T-2680: both front pinnacle apexes read within about 1 px of the lowered crown. Left of the south-east pier, the print shows dark coursed wall up to the coping's line (y 158), where the render's south side stops at y 182. The isolated render has no neighbours, so this is either Keith's south parapet or the house in front of it at 1812, and this distant view cannot say which.
T-2681: the loggia's columns 0.2 m taller and its balcony 0.3 m higher move it 4-6 px here, inside this camera's 4.6 px RMS; this view cannot tell the old heights from the new.

T-2714: the checker band's units are pitched 0.28 m along their rows (0.336 m before), with 0.07 m of ground between neighbours, as the 1888 Keith plate lays them; the rows are unchanged. Not judged here: Keith's front is not seen from this side; the band is not in the frame.

T-2813: re-rendered with Keith's crown 0.16 m lower (the moulded course under the lattice 0.20 m deep where it was 0.36 m, the checker and head bands unmoved); its camera re-solved on the moved crown controls (3.28 to 3.39 px RMS, tools/keith_crown_resolve.py). Read again at the crown beside the previous render: the lattice, coping and pinnacles move a few pixels at this picture's scale and nothing it shows opens a difference; the verdict stands as it was (matches).

T-2876: re-rendered on the GLB in the tree, T-2845's loggia (0.6 m pedestals at the first-floor plan's place, each pair's shafts 0.36 m apart, the flight 1.8 m clear and the stoop 0.15 m south), and read again beside the previous render and the picture: the render changes only at the loggia (x 318-420, y 187-524), which the 1941 view sees end-on behind 1812's front and trees; nothing it shows of Keith moved. Nothing it shows opens a difference; the verdict returns to matches.

T-2881: re-rendered on the loggia with its rear row built (a pedestal 0.6 m square against the wall behind each front one, carrying a pair of turned shafts 0.39 m off the wall at a 0.28 m pitch, their radii 0.78 of the front's, under a paired capital; tools/keith_loggia_rear_read.py, docs/RESEARCH/photo-match/keith_house_1808_prairie/keith-loggia-rear-read.json), and read again beside the previous render and the picture: the render changes only at the loggia (x 348-359, y 417-465), which the 1941 view sees end-on behind 1812's front and trees; the rear north pair stands inside the loggia's dark, where this view shows nothing of it. Nothing it shows opens a difference; the verdict returns to matches.

T-2882: re-rendered on the loggia with a respond on the wall behind each rear pair (a flat pier the rear pedestal's width, 0.25 m deep, from the pedestal's top to the ceiling; tools/keith_loggia_respond_read.py, docs/RESEARCH/photo-match/keith_house_1808_prairie/keith-loggia-respond-read.json), and read again beside the previous render and the picture: the render changes only at the loggia (x 348-350, y 421-461); the rear row stands behind the respond's face, and this picture does not read the rear row, for the reason T-2881's item above gives, so it does not read the respond either. Nothing it shows opens a difference; the verdict stands (matches).

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
